content.title: Exploring Narrative Approaches to Career Guidance in Upper Secondary Education
content.abstract: Context: Contemporary careers are increasingly uncertain and non-linear, making traditional information-based guidance less effective for supporting young people’s transitions. Narrative approaches have therefore gained relevance, as they promote self-reflection, identity construction, and exploration of possible futures. This paper examines two school-based narrative guidance pathways designed by the University of Turin: a photovoice-inspired pathway and a rap music pathway.
